title: Quick Tip: Get Ready: Upcoming Mandatory Features in Business Central Release Wave 27.0
summary: Release Wave 27.0 of Dynamics 365 Business Central introduces mandatory features focused on performance, usability, and security. Organizations should enable and test these features in sandbox environments now to ensure extension compatibility before they become mandatory.
key_points: Multiple new features will become mandatory in Wave 27.0, including optimized text search, server certificate validation, and auto-save capabilities
Features are available in Feature Management and should be tested in sandbox environments before they become compulsory
Extensions and apps may require updates to maintain compatibility with the mandatory features
The changes span multiple areas including warehouse operations, currency revaluation, tax forms, and navigation search
features: Enable multiple users to post warehouse entries simultaneously
Use optimized text search in lists
Enable server certificate validation for HTTP requests
Enable advanced navigation search with semantic similarity
Optimize screen estate usage on the web

quotes.text: To avoid any surprises, it's a good idea to enable and test these features now.
quotes.why_it_matters: Proactive testing helps identify compatibility issues with extensions before features become mandatory

quotes.text: While these updates are designed to improve performance, usability, and security, they could also affect your current extensions and apps.
quotes.why_it_matters: Organizations need to understand that mandatory features may require extension updates and plan accordingly
